pcvs.name: new_full_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Counts loop iterations, each generating extra keys, slicing tokens, and computing one chained hash.

pcvs.name: hashing_active
pcvs.rationale: Captures setup and termination costs skipped by the early return.

pcvs.name: new_full_block_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures token slicing, tuple construction, and serialization work proportional to the number of tokens hashed.

attempts.hypothesis: All 124 measured calls returned before hashing. Their cost should be approximately constant across token counts; including token count exposes the distinct entry states hidden by the previous all-zero predictors.

pcvs.name: num_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes entry states within the observed early-return path, allowing its approximately constant instruction cost to be evaluated across sufficient states.
